mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.name, c.slug, c.description, COUNT(a.id) AS article_count FROM category c LEFT JOIN article a ON a.category_id = c.id AND a.status = 1 WHERE c.scope = #{scope} GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.slug, c.description ORDER BY c.id ASC
SELECT id, scope, parent_id, name, slug, description, sort, gmt_create, gmt_modified FROM category WHERE scope = #{scope} AND slug = #{slug} LIMIT 1
